cards.observation: Misr ki hazaaron saal purani kabron mein archaeologists ko shahad ke bartan mile. Shahad kharab nahi hua tha.
cards.question: Shahad itne saal kharab kyun nahi hua?
example_sawal: Shahad kharab kyun nahi hota?
Koi khaana hazaaron saal kaise tik sakta hai?
options: Usme koi preservative milaya gaya tha
Usme paani bahut kam aur acid zyada hai, bacteria badh nahi paate
Kabr mein bilkul hawa nahi thi
cards.explanation: Shahad mein sirf ~17% paani hai aur wo acidic hai (pH ~3.9). Bacteria ka paani shahad kheench leta hai, wo badh nahi paate.
cards.source: Lab mein shahad ki water activity aur pH naapi gayi, aur bacteria daal ke dekha gaya ki wo badhte hain ya nahi.
cards.followup_sawal: Phir bhi doctor 1 saal se chhote bachche ko shahad dene se mana kyun karte hain?
cards.followup_answer: Spores shahad mein zinda reh sakte hain, bas badhte nahi. Badon ki aant unhe rok leti hai, chhote bachche ki nahi.
followup_options: Bahut meetha hai, daant kharab honge
Usme botulism bacteria ke spores ho sakte hain jo bachche ki aant mein badh jaate hain
Har bachche ko allergy hoti hai
cards.followup_source: Infant botulism ke case records (CDC, 1970s se) mein kai bimaar bachchon ko shahad diya gaya tha.

cards.observation: Leh (lagbhag 3500 m) mein paani jaldi ubal jaata hai, phir bhi daal-chawal pakne mein kaafi zyada time lagta hai.
cards.question: Paani jaldi ubalta hai, phir bhi khaana der se kyun pakta hai?
example_sawal: Paani jaldi ubal ke bhi khaana der se kyun pakta hai?
Oonchaai paani ko kaise badalti hai?
options: Kam hawa ke dabaav mein paani ~88°C pe hi ubal jaata hai, khaane ko kam garmi milti hai
Thand se bartan garam hi nahi hota
Wahan ki daal alag kism ki hai
cards.explanation: Paani ka boiling point hawa ke dabaav pe tika hai. Upar dabaav kam hai, to paani 100°C se pehle ubalta hai aur usse zyada garam nahi hota.
cards.source: Boiling point aur pressure ka rishta lab mein naapa gaya hai. 3500 m pe ye lagbhag 88-89°C aata hai.
cards.followup_sawal: Pressure cooker khaana jaldi kaise pakata hai?
cards.followup_answer: Cooker andar ka dabaav lagbhag doguna kar deta hai. Paani 120°C tak garam ho paata hai, to khaana tez pakta hai.
followup_options: Bhaap khaane ke andar ghus jaati hai
Dabaav badha ke paani ka boiling point ~120°C tak le jaata hai
Bas dhakkan band hai, aur kuch nahi
cards.followup_source: Cooker ke andar thermometer aur pressure gauge se naapa gaya: ~1 bar extra dabaav pe ~120°C.

cards.observation: Saabut pyaaz soonghne pe aansu nahi aate. Chaaku lagte hi aate hain.
cards.question: Pyaaz kaatne pe hi aansu kyun aate hain?
example_sawal: Kaatne pe hi aansu kyun aate hain?
Pyaaz ka asar aankh tak kaise pahunchta hai?
options: Ras ki boondein udke aankh mein jaati hain
Cells tootne pe ek enzyme udne waali gas banata hai jo aankh tak pahunchti hai
Chaaku ka metal pyaaz se react karta hai
Bas pyaaz ki khushboo tez hai
cards.explanation: Saabut pyaaz mein chemicals alag-alag band rehte hain. Kaatne pe wo milte hain aur ek enzyme ek gas banata hai jo aankh ko chubhti hai.
cards.source: 2002 mein Japan ke scientists (Imai et al.) ne Nature journal mein wo enzyme dhoondh ke chhapa.
cards.followup_sawal: Pyaaz pakaane ke baad meetha kyun lagne lagta hai?
cards.followup_answer: Pyaaz mein pehle se kaafi sugar hai. Garmi teekhe sulfur compounds tod deti hai aur sugar caramelize hone lagti hai.
followup_options: Garmi teekhe sulfur chemicals tod deti hai, andar ki sugar mehsoos hoti hai
Pyaaz garmi mein paani sokh leta hai
cards.followup_source: Kachche aur pake pyaaz ka chemical analysis karke sulfur compounds aur sugar naape gaye.

cards.observation: Kai mehenge restaurants menu pe "₹450" nahi, sirf "450" likhte hain.
cards.question: Menu se ₹ ka sign kyun hataate hain?
example_sawal: Menu se ₹ ka nishaan kyun hataate hain?
Nishaan hatane se kharch pe kaise asar padta hai?
options: Design saaf dikhta hai, aur kuch nahi
₹ dekh ke paise kharch hone ki feeling aati hai; bina nishaan log zyada kharch karte hain
Tax ke kisi niyam ki wajah se
cards.explanation: Currency ka nishaan dimaag ko "paisa ja raha hai" yaad dilata hai. Sirf number dekh ke log thoda zyada kharch karte paaye gaye.
cards.source: Cornell University ki 2009 study: ek restaurant mein alag-alag menu diye gaye; bina currency nishaan wale menu pe log zyada kharch kiye.
cards.followup_sawal: Dukaanon mein "₹99" jaisi keemat kyun hoti hai, "₹100" kyun nahi?
cards.followup_answer: Hum number baayein se padhte hain aur pehle digit pe zyada dhyaan dete hain. Isliye ek rupaya kam bhi kaafi sasta lagta hai.
followup_options: Dimaag pehla digit zyada dekhta hai; 99 "90-kuch" lagta hai
Bas purani aadat, koi asar nahi
cards.followup_source: Thomas aur Morwitz (2005) ke experiments mein log .99 wali keemat ko kaafi sasta samjha, jab pehla digit badla.

cards.observation: Mumbai ke dabbawale roz lagbhag 2 lakh dabbe ghar se office aur wapas pahunchaate hain. Bina app, bina computer.
cards.question: Sahi dabba sahi office tak kaise pahunchta hai?
example_sawal: Bina computer itne dabbe sahi jagah kaise pahunchte hain?
Dabba kabhi badalta kyun nahi?
options: Dabbe pe rang aur number ka chhota code: station, building, floor
Har dabbawala sirf ek ghar ka dabba le jaata hai
Office wale khud station se utha lete hain
cards.explanation: Dhakkan ke code se pata chalta hai kahan se uthaana, kis station pe utaarna, kaunsi building aur floor. Sab local train ke time pe chalta hai.
cards.source: Harvard Business School ne 2010 mein is system pe case study likhi, dabbawalon ke kaam ko step by step dekh ke.
cards.followup_sawal: Ye system kitna purana hai?
cards.followup_answer: Ye kaam 1890 ke aas-paas shuru hua, jab Bombay mein office jaane waalon ko ghar ka khaana chahiye tha.
cards.followup_source: Dabbawala association ke itihaas mein Mahadeo Havaji Bachche ka naam 1890 ke saath record mein hai.

cards.observation: NASA ke Curiosity rover ne Mars pe sunset ki photo li. Wahan sunset blue tha.
cards.question: Mars pe sunset blue kyun dikhta hai?
example_sawal: Mars pe sunset blue kyun hota hai?
Earth pe red aur Mars pe blue kaise?
options: Mars ka suraj blue dikhta hai
Mars ki dhool ke chhote particles blue light ko suraj ki disha mein hi aage bhejte hain
Wahan ki hawa mein bahut paani hai
cards.explanation: Mars ki hawa patli hai par dhool bahut hai. Dhool ke particles ek khaas size ke hain jo blue light ko suraj ke aas-paas hi bikherte hain.
cards.source: Curiosity ne April 2015 mein Gale crater se ye photos li. Dhool ke particles ka size rover aur orbiter se naapa gaya.
cards.followup_sawal: To Earth pe din mein aasmaan blue kyun hai?
cards.followup_answer: Chhoti wavelength (blue) hawa se zyada bikharti hai, to har taraf se blue light aati hai. Sunset pe blue raaste mein bikhar jaati hai, red bachti hai.
followup_options: Samundar ka rang upar dikhta hai
Hawa ke molecules blue light ko red se zyada bikherte hain
cards.followup_source: Lord Rayleigh ne 1871 mein iska hisaab nikala; baad ki measurements ne use sahi paaya.

cards.observation: Tumhare body mein lagbhag 38 lakh crore bacteria hain. Tumhare apne cells se thode zyada.
cards.question: Inme se zyada tar bacteria body mein kahan rehte hain?
example_sawal: Body mein itne bacteria kaise jee lete hain?
Ye bacteria body mein kahan rehte hain?
cards.explanation: Lagbhag saare bacteria badi aant mein hain. Wahan khaana dheere chalta hai aur unhe khaana milta rehta hai.
cards.source: 2016 mein Sender, Fuchs aur Milo ne aant ka volume aur bacteria density naap ke hisaab lagaya (PLOS Biology).
cards.followup_sawal: Pehle kaha jaata tha bacteria hamare cells se 10 guna hain. Wo number kahan se aaya?
cards.followup_answer: 1970s ke ek rough andaaze ko log saalon quote karte rahe. Dobara hisaab hua to ratio lagbhag 1.3 : 1 nikla.
followup_options: Ek purane mote andaaze se jo theek se check nahi hua
cards.followup_source: Sender et al. (2016) ne 10:1 claim ka source (Luckey, 1972) dhoondha aur naye data se dobara calculate kiya.

cards.observation: Cleopatra ka zamana Great Pyramid banne se zyada, Chaand pe insaan ke pahunchne ke paas tha.
cards.question: Ye kaise possible hai?
example_sawal: Ye kaise ho sakta hai?
Pyramid kitna purana hai?
options: Pyramid Cleopatra ne hi banwaya tha
Misr (Egypt) ki civilization 3000 saal chali: pyramid shuru mein bana, Cleopatra aakhir mein thi
Cleopatra ki date galat likhi gayi
cards.explanation: Great Pyramid ~2560 BCE mein bana. Cleopatra ki maut 30 BCE mein hui. Chaand landing 1969. Pehla gap ~2500 saal, doosra ~2000.
cards.source: Pyramid ke mortar ki radiocarbon dating aur Roman records se dono dates pakki hain.
cards.followup_sawal: Great Pyramid kis liye bana tha?
cards.followup_answer: Ye pharaoh Khufu ki kabr thi. Andar ke chamber mein granite ka bada taboot (sarcophagus) hai.
cards.followup_source: Andar ke chambers mein mazdooron ne Khufu ka naam likha tha. Wadi al-Jarf mein pathar dhone waale ek afsar ki diary bhi mili.

cards.observation: Shatranj ki "Queen" pehle board ke sabse kamzor mohron mein se ek thi.
cards.question: Shuru mein Queen asal mein kya thi?
example_sawal: Queen itni taakatwar kaise bani?
Mohron ki chaal kyun badli?
options: Raja ka mantri (wazir), jo sirf 1 khana diagonal chalta tha
cards.explanation: India ke chaturanga aur Persian shatranj mein ye mohra mantri tha. Wo bas ek khana diagonal chal sakta tha.
cards.source: Purani Persian aur Arabic shatranj ki kitaabon mein mohron ki chaal likhi mili hai.
cards.followup_sawal: Queen ko aaj wali taakat kab mili?
cards.followup_answer: 1400s ke aakhir mein naye rules aaye aur khel bahut tez ho gaya. Ye rules jaldi poore Europe mein phail gaye.
cards.followup_source: Lucena ki 1497 ki chess kitaab aur Valencia ki ek kavita (~1475) mein nayi Queen ki chaal likhi mili.

cards.observation: Octopus ke teen dil hote hain aur uska khoon blue hota hai.
cards.question: Octopus ka khoon blue kyun hota hai?
example_sawal: Octopus ka khoon blue kyun hai?
Teen dil kis kaam aate hain?
options: Usme copper wala protein (hemocyanin) oxygen dhota hai
Samundar ka paani khoon mein milta hai
cards.explanation: Hamare khoon mein iron wala hemoglobin hai jo red hai. Octopus mein copper wala hemocyanin hai, jo oxygen ke saath blue dikhta hai.
cards.source: Octopus ke khoon ke chemical analysis se protein aur usme copper pehchana gaya.
cards.followup_sawal: Teen mein se ek dil tairte waqt kya karta hai?
cards.followup_answer: Do dil gills ko khoon bhejte hain, teesra baaki body ko. Tairte waqt teesra ruk jaata hai, isliye octopus aksar rengna pasand karta hai.
followup_options: Sirf dimaag ko khoon bhejta hai
cards.followup_source: Tairte aur rengte octopus ki dhadkan ki measurements (Wells, 1970s-80s) mein ye dekha gaya.

cards.observation: Seattle mein scientists ne ek khaas nakaab pehen ke kuch kauve pakde. Saalon baad bhi kauve us nakaab ko dekh ke chillaate the.
cards.question: Jo kauve kabhi pakde hi nahi gaye, unhone kya kiya?
example_sawal: Kauve chehra kaise yaad rakhte hain?
Kauve ek doosre ko khatra kaise batate hain?
options: Kuch nahi, unhe pata hi nahi tha
Wo bhi chillaane lage, doosre kauvon se seekh liya
Nakaab wale se khaana maangne aaye
cards.explanation: Kauve chehra yaad rakhte hain aur "khatra" doosron ko sikha dete hain. Baad mein paida hue kauve bhi chillaane lage.
cards.source: University of Washington (John Marzluff) ki study: 2006 se saalon tak nakaab pehen ke ghoome aur chillaane waale kauve gine.
cards.followup_sawal: New Caledonia ke kauve lab mein kya karte dikhe?
cards.followup_answer: Oxford lab mein Betty naam ki kauvi ne seedha taar mod ke hook banaya aur tube se khaane ki baalti nikaali.
followup_options: Taar mod ke hook banaya aur khaana nikaala
cards.followup_source: 2002 mein Science journal mein video ke saath ye experiment chhapa (Weir, Chappell, Kacelnik).

cards.observation: Ek doctor ne 60 saal tak sirf baayein haath ki ungliyaan chatkaayin, daayein ki kabhi nahi.
cards.question: 60 saal baad kya nikla?
example_sawal: Ungli chatkaane se haath ko kya hota hai?
Chatak ki awaaz kyun aati hai?
options: Dono haathon mein koi farq nahi
cards.explanation: Dono haathon mein arthritis nahi mila. Badi studies mein bhi ungli chatkaane aur arthritis ka seedha rishta nahi mila.
cards.source: Dr. Donald Unger ne 1998 mein journal Arthritis & Rheumatism mein apna result chhapa.
cards.followup_sawal: "Chatak" ki awaaz kahan se aati hai?
cards.followup_answer: Joint khinchne pe andar ka dabaav girta hai aur liquid mein achanak gas ki jagah banti hai. Wahi "chatak" hai.
followup_options: Joint ke liquid mein achanak gas ki khaali jagah banne se
cards.followup_source: 2015 mein Canada ke scientists ne MRI mein real time ungli chatakti dekhi (Kawchuk et al., PLOS ONE).

cards.observation: Kela thoda sa radioactive hota hai.
cards.question: Kela radioactive kyun hota hai?
example_sawal: Kela radioactive kaise ho sakta hai?
Kya roz kela khaana theek hai?
options: Usme potassium hai, aur natural potassium ka chhota hissa (K-40) radioactive hai
cards.explanation: Har potassium ka lagbhag 0.012% hissa K-40 hota hai. Kele mein potassium zyada hai, to thodi si radiation.
cards.source: Gamma spectrometry se kele aur doosre khaane ki radiation naapi gayi hai.
cards.followup_sawal: Bahut kele khaane se radiation body mein jama hoti hai?
cards.followup_answer: Body potassium ka level lagbhag fix rakhti hai; extra kidney bahar nikaal deti hai. Isliye K-40 jama nahi hota.
followup_options: Nahi, body potassium ka level fix rakhti hai, extra bahar nikal jaata hai
cards.followup_source: Whole-body counters se insaan ke andar ka potassium naapa gaya; wo khaane se lagbhag nahi badalta.

cards.observation: Assam ke kai chai bagaan apni ghadi IST se 1 ghanta aage rakhte hain. Ise "Bagan time" kehte hain.
cards.question: Ye bagaan ghadi 1 ghanta aage kyun rakhte hain?
example_sawal: Ek desh mein do time kyun?
Ghadi aage karne se kya fayda?
options: British ne London ke time se joda tha
Wahan suraj IST ke hisaab se kaafi jaldi ugta aur doobta hai; din ki roshni bachti hai
Kisi ki galti chalti aa rahi hai
cards.explanation: IST 82.5°E longitude se tay hai. Assam kaafi poorab mein hai, to wahan suraj lagbhag ek ghanta pehle ugta hai.
cards.source: Sunrise ke records aur longitude ke hisaab se ye farq naapa gaya. Bagan time British zamane se chal raha hai.
cards.followup_sawal: IST kis jagah ke time pe tika hai?
cards.followup_answer: IST ki reference line 82.5°E hai, jo UP mein Mirzapur ke paas se guzarti hai, desh ke beech ke aas-paas.
cards.followup_source: CSIR-NPL (National Physical Laboratory, Delhi) atomic ghadiyon se IST chalati hai, isi longitude ke hisaab se.

cards.observation: 500 saal pehle Bharat ke khaane mein laal-hari mirch thi hi nahi.
cards.question: To pehle teekha kis se banta tha?
example_sawal: Mirch Bharat kaise pahunchi?
Pehle khaana teekha kaise banta tha?
options: Teekha khaana hota hi nahi tha
cards.explanation: Mirch America se aayi; Portuguese 1500s mein Goa laaye. Usse pehle kaali mirch aur pippali teekhapan deti thi.
cards.source: Genetics aur archaeology se mirch ka ghar Mexico-South America nikla. Purani Indian recipes mein kaali mirch hai, mirch nahi.
cards.followup_sawal: Mirch khaane pe "jalan" kyun lagti hai?
cards.followup_answer: Capsaicin jeebh ka garmi waala sensor on kar deta hai. Dimaag ko lagta hai jal raha hai, temperature nahi badalta.
followup_options: Wo sach mein garam hoti hai
Capsaicin wahi sensor (TRPV1) jagaata hai jo garmi pe jaagta hai
Acid se chhote zakhm hote hain
cards.followup_source: David Julius ki team ne 1997 mein TRPV1 dhoondha. Is kaam ke liye 2021 ka Nobel mila.

cards.observation: New York ki Empire State Building pe saal mein lagbhag 20-25 baar bijli girti hai.
cards.question: Bijli ek hi building pe baar-baar kyun girti hai?
example_sawal: Bijli ek hi jagah baar baar kyun girti hai?
Bijli girne ki jagah kaise tay hoti hai?
options: Wo bahut oonchi hai; bijli ko zameen tak sabse easy raasta wahi deti hai
Lightning rod doosre shehron ki bijli kheenchti hai
cards.explanation: Bijli aksar sabse oonchi conducting cheez pe girti hai. "Ek jagah do baar nahi girti" wali baat galat hai.
cards.source: 1930s se building pe strikes record kiye gaye (General Electric ki measurements); aaj lightning detection networks ginte hain.
cards.followup_sawal: Chamak ke baad garaj der se kyun sunai deti hai?
cards.followup_answer: Dono saath bante hain. Awaaz ~1 km 3 second mein chalti hai, roshni lagbhag turant pahunch jaati hai.
followup_options: Roshni awaaz se lakhon guna tez chalti hai
cards.followup_source: Hawa mein awaaz ki speed (~343 m/s) baar-baar naapi gayi hai.

cards.observation: Ek hi strawberry mousse safed plate pe kaali plate se zyada meetha laga.
cards.question: Safed plate pe mousse zyada meetha kyun laga?
example_sawal: Plate ka rang taste kaise badalta hai?
Restaurant plate ka rang kyun soch ke chunte hain?
options: Safed plate zyada saaf lagti hai
Dimaag rang aur contrast se taste ka andaaza lagaata hai
Kaali plate garam ho jaati hai
Safed plate mein zyada mousse tha
cards.explanation: Taste sirf jeebh nahi, dimaag ka andaaza bhi hai. Rang aur contrast us andaaze ko badal dete hain.
cards.source: Oxford ki Crossmodal lab (2012): logon ne dono plates pe same mousse chakha; safed pe ~10% zyada meetha bataaya.
cards.followup_sawal: Kya music bhi taste badal sakta hai?
cards.followup_answer: Experiments mein same toffee oonche, halke suron ke saath meethi aur bhaari suron ke saath kadwi lagi.
followup_options: Haan, oonche sur cheez ko zyada meetha aur bhaari sur kadwa lagwa sakte hain
cards.followup_source: Oxford ke Crisinel aur Spence ki 2012 study, "bittersweet symphony" naam se chhapi.

cards.observation: Ullu apni gardan lagbhag 270° ghuma leta hai. Phir bhi dimaag ka khoon band nahi hota.
cards.question: Gardan itni ghuma ke bhi khoon kaise nahi rukta?
example_sawal: Ullu gardan itni kaise ghumata hai?
Khoon kyun nahi rukta?
options: Gardan mein 14 haddiyan aur naso mein khoon jama rakhne ki jagah
Wo us waqt saans rok leta hai
Ullu ke dimaag ko khoon nahi chahiye
cards.explanation: Insaan ki gardan mein 7 haddiyan, ullu mein 14. Naso mein khaas jagah hai jahan khoon jama rehta hai jab gardan mudti hai.
cards.source: Johns Hopkins ke scientists ne 2013 mein ullu ki naso mein dye daal ke X-ray (angiography) se dekha.
cards.followup_sawal: Ullu ko gardan ghumani hi kyun padti hai?
cards.followup_answer: Ullu ki aankhen gol nahi, lambi tube jaisi hain aur socket mein fit hain. Dekhne ke liye poora sir ghumana padta hai.
followup_options: Aankhen tube jaisi hain aur socket mein fix, ghoom nahi sakti
cards.followup_source: Ullu ki aankh aur khopdi ki anatomy studies se.

cards.observation: 1969 mein Ahmedabad ke ek sarkari karmachari ne ghar ke peeche detergent banaya aur office ke baad cycle pe ghar-ghar becha.
cards.question: Bade detergent brands ke saamne wo kaise tika?
example_sawal: Itna sasta becha to kamaaya kaise?
Bade brands ne jawab kaise diya?
options: Bahut saare TV ads chala ke
Bade brands se kaafi kam keemat pe bech ke
cards.explanation: Karsanbhai Patel ka Nirma us waqt ke bade brands se kai guna sasta tha. Wo khud ghar-ghar jaake bechte the.
cards.source: Nirma Ltd. company history; Karsanbhai Patel ke published interviews
cards.followup_sawal: Detergent ka naam "Nirma" kahan se aaya?
cards.followup_answer: Karsanbhai Patel ki beti Nirupama ke naam se.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhari sabse sasti cheez kaun khareedta hai, aur kyun?

cards.observation: 1980s mein Tamil Nadu ke ek chhote business ne shampoo bottle ki jagah ₹1 ke chhote sachet mein becha.
cards.question: Sachet se sabse bada fark kya pada?
example_sawal: Chhota pack bechne se kya badla?
Gaon tak shampoo kaise pahuncha?
options: Gaon aur kam paise waale log bhi ek baar mein khareed paaye
cards.explanation: Bottle ek saath mehengi padti thi. ₹1 ke sachet se shampoo roz ke kharche mein aa gaya, aur Chik kuch saalon mein South India ka top shampoo bana.
cards.source: CavinKare company history; Madras Musings, "The man behind the sachet revolution in India"
cards.followup_sawal: Sachet packing ka idea is parivar mein pehle kisne try kiya tha?
cards.followup_answer: C.K. Ranganathan ke pita R. Chinni Krishnan ne pehle sachet packing pe kaam kiya tha; Ranganathan ne use Chik ke saath bade paimane pe chalaya.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Kya tumhari koi cheez chhote pack mein naye customer la sakti hai? Ye kaise check karoge?

cards.observation: 1977 mein Coca-Cola ne India mein apna business band kar diya aur 16 saal baad lauti.
cards.question: Coca-Cola ne India kyun chhoda?
example_sawal: Ek company itna bada market kyun chhodegi?
Kanoon ne kya maanga tha?
options: FERA kanoon ke tahat Indian hissedari badhane aur formula share karne ki shart
cards.explanation: Sarkar ne FERA ke tahat Indian hissedari badhane aur formula batane ko kaha. Coca-Cola ne mana kiya aur 1977 mein nikal gayi.
cards.source: Lok Sabha records, 1977 (Industries Minister George Fernandes ka bayan); Coca-Cola India company history
cards.followup_sawal: Coca-Cola India mein dobara kab aayi, aur aate hi kya kiya?
cards.followup_answer: 1993 mein, liberalisation ke baad. Usi saal Parle ke drinks (Thums Up, Limca, Gold Spot) khareed liye.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Agar koi naya niyam tumhare kaam ka tareeka badal de, tum sabse pehle kya check karoge?

cards.observation: June 2015 mein India ka sabse bada instant noodle brand achanak dukaanon se gayab ho gaya.
cards.question: Kya hua tha?
example_sawal: Ek brand raaton-raat kaise gayab hua?
Ban kisne lagaya aur kyun?
options: FSSAI ne lead aur "No added MSG" label pe sawal uthaake ban lagaya
Company ne price war mein khud hataya
cards.explanation: FSSAI ne 5 June 2015 ko Maggi pe ban ka order diya. Nestlé ne stock wapas mangaya aur court gayi.
cards.source: FSSAI order, 5 June 2015; Nestlé India press releases; Bombay High Court order, Aug 2015
cards.followup_sawal: Maggi wapas kab aayi?
cards.followup_answer: Bombay High Court ne Aug 2015 mein ban hataya; naye tests ke baad Maggi November 2015 mein wapas launch hui.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Agar kal tumhara sabse bikne wala item band ho jaaye, customer kya karenge? Kaise pata karoge?

cards.observation: Parle-G ka ₹5 wala packet saalon tak ₹5 hi raha, jabki baaki sab mehenga hota gaya.
cards.question: Mehngai mein company ne kya kiya?
example_sawal: Daam same rakh ke kharcha kaise nikla?
Customer ko pata chala kya?
cards.explanation: Parle ke Mayank Shah ne 2019 mein bataya ki ₹5 pack Dec 2018 se 70g se 65g kiya gaya. Daam wahi, maal thoda kam.
cards.source: Business Today interview, Mayank Shah (Parle Products), Aug 2019
cards.followup_sawal: Is tareeke ko kya kehte hain, aur Parle ne ye dobara kiya?
cards.followup_answer: Ise shrinkflation kehte hain. 2021 mein bhi Parle ne ₹20 se neeche ke packs ka weight ghataya aur upar ke packs ka daam badhaya (PTI/Economic Times).
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare customers daam badalne pe zyada react karte hain ya portion badalne pe?

cards.observation: McDonald's ka pehla India restaurant 1996 mein Delhi mein khula. Menu mein Big Mac nahi tha.
cards.question: Big Mac ki jagah kya tha?
example_sawal: Global brand ne apna sabse famous burger kyun hataya?
India mein menu kaise badla?
options: Maharaja Mac, jo beef nahi balki mutton se bana
cards.explanation: India mein beef aur pork menu se bahar rakhe gaye. Big Mac ki jagah Maharaja Mac aaya, pehle mutton ka, baad mein chicken ka.
cards.source: McDonald's India company history (pehla restaurant Basant Lok, Delhi, 1996)
cards.followup_sawal: McDonald's India veg aur non-veg ko kaise sambhalta hai?
cards.followup_answer: Company ke mutabik veg aur non-veg khaana storage se cooking tak alag rakha jaata hai.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare menu ka kaunsa item sirf tumhare shehar ki pasand ki wajah se chalta hai?

cards.observation: Amul ka maalik koi ek seth ya private company nahi hai.
cards.question: To maalik kaun hai?
example_sawal: Kisan brand ke maalik kaise ban sakte hain?
Itna bada brand bina seth ke kaise chalta hai?
options: Gujarat ke lakhon doodh utpadak kisan, cooperative ke zariye
cards.explanation: Amul brand GCMMF ka hai, jo Gujarat ki district milk unions ka federation hai. Unions ke member khud kisan hain.
cards.source: GCMMF (Amul) annual reports; NDDB records
cards.followup_sawal: Operation Flood ka isme kya role tha?
cards.followup_answer: 1970 mein NDDB ne Verghese Kurien ki agwai mein Operation Flood shuru kiya, jisne Amul jaisa cooperative model desh bhar mein phailaya.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare supplier tumse kitne jude hain? Agar wo hissedar hote to kya badalta?

cards.observation: Zomato 2008 mein "Foodiebay" naam se shuru hua tha, aur tab khaana deliver nahi karta tha.
cards.question: Shuru mein Foodiebay kya karta tha?
example_sawal: Menu website delivery app kaise bani?
Naam kyun badla?
options: Restaurants ke menu scan karke website pe daalta tha
cards.explanation: Deepinder Goyal aur Pankaj Chaddah ne restaurant menus online daalne se shuruaat ki. 2010 mein naam Zomato hua.
cards.source: Zomato DRHP (2021); Zomato company history
cards.followup_sawal: Zomato ne food delivery kab shuru ki?
cards.followup_answer: 2015 mein, website shuru hone ke lagbhag 7 saal baad.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhara business shuru mein kya karta tha jo aaj nahi karta?

cards.observation: Netflix 1997 mein bani thi, internet streaming aam hone se kaafi pehle.
cards.question: Shuru mein Netflix kya karti thi?
example_sawal: DVD wali company streaming tak kaise pahunchi?
Purana business kab tak chala?
options: DVD dak se ghar bhejti thi
cards.explanation: Netflix ne DVD rental by mail se shuruaat ki. Streaming 2007 mein aayi.
cards.source: Netflix company history; Netflix SEC filings
cards.followup_sawal: Netflix ne DVD mail service kab band ki?
cards.followup_answer: September 2023 mein, lagbhag 25 saal baad.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare business ka kaunsa kaam aaj chal raha hai par 5 saal mein badal sakta hai?

cards.observation: Tata ki ₹1 lakh wali Nano car ki factory Singur (Bengal) mein lagbhag tayyar thi. Phir bhi company ne Singur chhod diya.
cards.question: Kyun?
example_sawal: Tayyar factory kyun chhodi?
Factory kahan gayi?
options: Zameen lene ke khilaaf bade andolan ki wajah se
Sarkar ne car pe ban lagaya
cards.explanation: Kisanon ki zameen lene pe bade andolan hue. 3 Oct 2008 ko Tata ne Singur chhodne ka elaan kiya aur plant Sanand (Gujarat) le gaye.
cards.source: Tata Motors press statement, 3 Oct 2008
cards.followup_sawal: Nano ka production kab band hua?
cards.followup_answer: 2018 tak production lagbhag ruk gaya; Tata Motors ke mutabik 2019 mein koi Nano nahi bani.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare business ka koi plan bahar ki wajah se ruka hai? Kya wo pehle se dikh sakta tha?

cards.observation: Sept 2016 mein ek naya mobile network launch hua jisme shuru mein voice aur data dono free the.
cards.question: Free offer kab tak chala?
example_sawal: Free dene se company kaise kamaati hai?
Free kab khatam hua?
options: Dec 2016 tak, phir badha ke March 2017 tak
cards.explanation: Jio ka "Welcome Offer" 31 Dec 2016 tak tha. "Happy New Year Offer" se ye March 2017 tak chala, phir paid plans aaye.
cards.source: Reliance Industries AGM (Sept 2016) aur Jio press releases
cards.followup_sawal: Paid plans ke baad voice calls ka kya hua?
cards.followup_answer: Jio ne voice calls free rakhe aur data ke paise liye. Oct 2019 se doosre network pe call ke liye charge shuru hua.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Agar tum ek cheez free do, to kaunsi doosri cheez ki sale badh sakti hai? Data mein kaise dekhoge?

cards.observation: Haldiram's ka naam kisi masale ya haldi se nahi aaya.
cards.question: Naam kahan se aaya?
example_sawal: Ek ghar ka naam brand kaise bana?
Shuruaat kahan hui?
options: Founder Ganga Bishan Agarwal ka ghar ka naam "Haldiram" tha
cards.explanation: 1937 mein Bikaner mein Ganga Bishan Agarwal ne chhoti dukaan kholi. Ghar mein unhe "Haldiram" bulate the, wahi brand bana.
cards.source: Haldiram's official founder history (1937, Bikaner)
cards.followup_sawal: Haldiram's ki shuruaat kis cheez se hui?
cards.followup_answer: Bikaner mein bhujia aur mithai ki ek chhoti dukaan se.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Customers tumhari dukaan ko kis naam se bulate hain? Kya wo board wala naam hi hai?

cards.observation: 2014 mein Swiggy ne food delivery shuru ki, jab zyada tar restaurants ke paas apne delivery boy nahi the.
cards.question: Swiggy ne delivery kaise ki?
example_sawal: Restaurant ke bina delivery boy delivery kaise?
Apni fleet kyun banayi?
cards.explanation: Swiggy ne shuru se apne delivery partners rakhe, taaki bina delivery staff wale restaurants bhi deliver kar saken.
cards.source: Swiggy DRHP (2024); Swiggy company history
cards.followup_sawal: Swiggy kahan shuru hua?
cards.followup_answer: Bengaluru mein, 2014 mein.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare kitne orders delivery se aate hain, aur kis area se? Data mein dekh sakte ho?

cards.observation: Hindustan Unilever ke products door ke gaon tak pahunchaane mein gaon ki auratein kaam karti hain.
cards.question: Ye system kya hai?
example_sawal: Badi company gaon tak kaise pahunchti hai?
Auratein kyun judti hain?
options: HUL ka Project Shakti: gaon ki auratein khud HUL products bechne wali entrepreneur banti hain
cards.explanation: 2001 mein HUL ne Project Shakti shuru kiya. Auratein HUL se maal leke apne aur aas-paas ke gaon mein bechti hain.
cards.source: Hindustan Unilever annual reports (Project Shakti)
cards.followup_sawal: Is model mein auraton ko kya milta hai?
cards.followup_answer: Bechne pe kamaai (margin) milti hai, aur HUL ko un gaon tak pahunch jahan dukaanon ka network kam hai.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare area mein kaun log hain jo pehle se tumhare customers ko jaante hain?

cards.observation: 1993 mein Coca-Cola ne India mein apne sabse bade rival Thums Up ko khareed liya.
cards.question: Khareedne ke baad Thums Up ka kya hua?
example_sawal: Rival khareed ke bhi uska brand kyun rakha?
Thums Up kahan se aaya?
options: Brand chalta raha aur aaj bhi bada brand hai
Naam badal ke Coke ho gaya
cards.explanation: Thums Up band nahi hua. Coca-Cola ne 2021 mein bataya ki Thums Up India mein billion-dollar brand ban gaya.
cards.source: Coca-Cola India statements (1993 acquisition; 2021 billion-dollar brand announcement)
cards.followup_sawal: Thums Up kab aur kisne banaya tha?
cards.followup_answer: 1977 mein Parle (Chauhan parivar) ne, Coca-Cola ke India chhodne ke baad.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare competitor ka kaunsa item customers ko itna pasand hai ki tum use copy nahi kar paoge?

cards.observation: Bisleri naam Italian hai, lekin aaj ka bada brand ek Indian parivar ne banaya.
cards.question: Bisleri Indian haathon mein kaise aaya?
example_sawal: Italian naam India mein kaise aaya?
Paani bechne ka idea kaise aaya?
options: India mein hi shuru hua tha
cards.explanation: 1969 mein Parle ne Bisleri brand khareeda. Baad mein Ramesh Chauhan ne ise packaged paani ka bada brand banaya.
cards.source: Bisleri International company history
cards.followup_sawal: Italy mein Bisleri asal mein kis cheez ke liye jaana jaata tha?
cards.followup_answer: Felice Bisleri ki company ek malaria ki dawa/tonic ke liye jaani jaati thi; paani baad mein aaya (company history ke mutabik).
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare brand ka naam customers ko kya yaad dilata hai?

cards.observation: 1996 mein Bengaluru ke Brigade Road pe pehla Café Coffee Day khula. Coffee ke saath ek aur cheez bikti thi.
cards.question: Pehle CCD mein coffee ke saath kya bikta tha?
example_sawal: Coffee shop mein internet kyun?
Café ka idea kahan se aaya?
cards.explanation: Pehla CCD cyber café jaisa tha, jahan coffee ke saath internet milta tha. Wo pehla outlet ab band ho chuka hai.
cards.source: New Indian Express, 31 July 2019 ("It all started as a cyber cafe in Bengaluru")
cards.followup_sawal: CCD ke founder ka coffee se kya rishta tha?
cards.followup_answer: V.G. Siddhartha ka parivar Karnataka mein coffee estates se juda tha, aur group khud coffee ugaane aur trade karne ka kaam karta tha.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Log tumhari jagah sirf khaane ke liye aate hain ya kisi aur wajah se bhi? Kaise pata karoge?

cards.observation: 1959 mein Mumbai mein saat auraton ne ₹80 udhaar leke papad banana shuru kiya.
cards.question: Aaj Lijjat ka maalik kaun hai?
example_sawal: ₹80 se itna bada brand kaise bana?
Maalik kaun hai?
options: Member auratein khud; ye ek cooperative jaisi sanstha hai
cards.explanation: Shri Mahila Griha Udyog Lijjat Papad mein member auratein hi maalik hain aur faida-nuksaan baantti hain.
cards.source: Lijjat official history; NDTV Food report on Lijjat's founding
cards.followup_sawal: Shuruaat kahan hui?
cards.followup_answer: 15 March 1959 ko Girgaum, Mumbai mein ek imaarat ki chhat pe.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare business mein kaam karne wale log kis cheez se jude rehte hain?

cards.observation: Flipkart 2007 mein Bengaluru mein do logon ne ek chhote flat se shuru kiya.
cards.question: Flipkart ne shuru mein kya becha?
example_sawal: Sirf kitaabon se kyun shuru kiya?
Baaki cheezein kab aayi?
cards.explanation: Sachin aur Binny Bansal ne online kitaabon se shuruaat ki, phir dheere-dheere categories badhaayi.
cards.source: Flipkart company history
cards.followup_sawal: Flipkart ko 2018 mein kisne khareeda?
cards.followup_answer: Walmart ne, lagbhag 77% hissa ~$16 billion mein.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhara sabse pehla bikne wala item kya tha, aur aaj wo kitna bikta hai?

cards.observation: Oct 2003 mein Maharashtra mein Cadbury Dairy Milk ke kuch bars mein keede mile.
cards.question: Cadbury ne iske baad kya badla?
example_sawal: Ek complaint ke baad brand kya karta hai?
Packaging kyun badli?
options: Naya sealed packaging laaya aur bade campaign se bharosa wapas laane ki koshish ki
cards.explanation: Cadbury naya, zyada seal hone wala wrapper laayi aur Amitabh Bachchan ke saath campaign chalaya.
cards.source: Maharashtra FDA action (Oct 2003); Cadbury India statements, news archives 2003-04
cards.followup_sawal: Cadbury ke mutabik keede kahan se aaye the?
cards.followup_answer: Company ne kaha factory se nahi, dukaan pe galat storage ki wajah se.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Agar ek customer kahe ki khaane mein kuch mila, to tum sabse pehle kya check karoge?

cards.observation: Oct 2012 mein Kingfisher Airlines ki udaanein rukin aur phir kabhi shuru nahi hui.
cards.question: Udaanein kyun rukin?
example_sawal: Airline achanak kaise band hoti hai?
Licence kyun gaya?
options: Staff strike ke baad DGCA ne licence suspend kiya
cards.explanation: Salary na milne pe staff strike pe gaya. DGCA ne 20 Oct 2012 ko safety aur funding plan na hone pe licence suspend kiya.
cards.source: DGCA order, 20 Oct 2012
cards.followup_sawal: Kya licence dobara mila?
cards.followup_answer: Nahi. Dec 2012 ke aakhir mein permit khatam (lapse) ho gaya aur airline wapas nahi udi.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare business ki sabse badi dependence kya hai, jo ruke to sab ruk jaaye?

cards.observation: 29 June 2020 ko India mein 59 apps ek saath block hue, jinme TikTok bhi tha.
cards.question: Kis kanoon ke tahat?
example_sawal: Ek din mein app kaise band hota hai?
Kanoon kya kehta hai?
options: IT Act ki Section 69A, desh ki suraksha ka hawala
cards.explanation: MeitY ne sovereignty aur security ka hawala dekar IT Act ki Section 69A ke tahat apps block kiye.
cards.source: MeitY press release, 29 June 2020 (PIB)
cards.followup_sawal: Ban ke baad short video ke liye kya aaya?
cards.followup_answer: Instagram ne July 2020 mein India mein Reels launch kiya; kai Indian short-video apps bhi aaye.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Agar tumhara sabse bada order channel (app) band ho jaaye, kitne customer seedha tumhe jaante hain?

cards.observation: Jan 2022 mein Air India 69 saal baad Tata ke paas wapas gayi.
cards.question: Air India pehle Tata se kaise alag hui thi?
example_sawal: Airline sarkar ke paas kaise gayi?
Wapas kaise aayi?
options: 1953 mein sarkar ne airlines ka rashtriyakaran kiya
Tata ne khud bech di thi
cards.explanation: J.R.D. Tata ne 1932 mein Tata Airlines shuru ki. 1953 mein Air Corporations Act se sarkar ne airline le li.
cards.source: Govt of India (DIPAM) disinvestment records; Tata Group history
cards.followup_sawal: Tata ne kitne mein wapas li?
cards.followup_answer: ₹18,000 crore ki boli se: lagbhag ₹2,700 crore cash aur baaki karz apne upar.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare business ka koi hissa pehle kisi aur ka tha? Usse kya seekha?

cards.observation: 2023 mein ek influencer ka video viral hua jisme Bournvita ki sugar pe sawal tha. Dec 2023 mein formula badla.
cards.question: Company ne kya badla?
example_sawal: Ek video se formula kaise badla?
Sugar kitni kam hui?
cards.explanation: Mondelez India ne naye formula mein added sugar 14.4% kam karne ki ghoshna ki.
cards.source: Mondelez India statement, Dec 2023 (NDTV report)
cards.followup_sawal: Kya kisi sarkari body ne bhi kuch kaha tha?
cards.followup_answer: Haan, NCPCR ne April 2023 mein company ko notice bheja aur claims pe sawal kiya.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare menu ka kaunsa item customer "healthy" samajh ke lete hain? Kya ye kabhi check kiya?

cards.observation: 1974 mein Delhi mein doodh ek machine se nikalne laga. Log ise "lohe ki bhains" kehne lage.
cards.question: Token machine ka fayda kya tha?
example_sawal: Machine se doodh kyun?
Pehle doodh kaise milta tha?
options: Har customer ko same maap aur same daam
cards.explanation: NDDB ne Operation Flood ke tahat Mother Dairy shuru ki. Token dispenser se har kisi ko same maap aur daam milta tha.
cards.source: Times of India, Sept 2024 (Mother Dairy ke 50 saal); NDDB records
cards.followup_sawal: Pehle booth kahan khule?
cards.followup_answer: 4 Nov 1974 ko Delhi ke Defence Colony aur RK Puram Sector 4 mein.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare customers ka sabse bada "darr" kya hai jab wo tumse khareedte hain?

cards.observation: Aug 2003 mein ek report aayi ki India mein bikne wale cold drinks mein pesticide residue hai.
cards.question: Report ke baad Parliament ne kya kiya?
example_sawal: Ek report se Parliament tak kaise pahuncha?
Companies ne kya kaha?
options: Joint Parliamentary Committee (JPC) banayi, jisne report ke findings sahi paaye
cards.explanation: CSE ki report pe JPC bani. Feb 2004 mein JPC ne kaha CSE ke findings sahi the aur standards ki zaroorat batayi.
cards.source: CSE report (Aug 2003); JPC report, Feb 2004
cards.followup_sawal: Badi cold drink companies ka jawab kya tha?
cards.followup_answer: Coca-Cola aur PepsiCo ne kaha unke products safe hain aur apne tests ka hawala diya.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare product ki quality ka saboot kya hai jo customer khud dekh sake?

cards.observation: Mobile phone ke liye mashhoor Nokia 1865 mein shuru hui thi.
cards.question: Shuru mein Nokia kya banati thi?
example_sawal: Paper se phone tak kaise?
Phone business kahan gaya?
cards.explanation: Finland mein Fredrik Idestam ki paper mill se shuruaat hui. Baad mein rubber, cable aur electronics aaye.
cards.source: Nokia company history
cards.followup_sawal: Nokia ne apna phone business kisko becha?
cards.followup_answer: Microsoft ko: deal 2013 mein hui, 2014 mein poori.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhari team ki skills se kaunsa doosra kaam ban sakta hai?

cards.observation: Nintendo video games se kai dashak pehle, 1889 mein bani thi.
cards.question: Tab Nintendo kya banati thi?
example_sawal: Cards se games tak kaise?
Console kab aaya?
cards.explanation: Kyoto mein Fusajiro Yamauchi ne haath se bane hanafuda cards se shuruaat ki.
cards.source: Nintendo company history
cards.followup_sawal: Nintendo ka pehla ghar ka video game console kab aaya?
cards.followup_answer: 1983 mein Japan mein, Famicom naam se.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare business ka sabse purana product aaj bhi kyun chal raha hai (ya kyun nahi)?

cards.observation: 1971 mein Seattle ka pehla Starbucks coffee drink nahi bechta tha.
cards.question: To kya bechta tha?
example_sawal: Coffee shop drink kyun nahi bechti thi?
Drinks kab aaye?
options: Coffee beans aur coffee banane ka saamaan
cards.explanation: Starbucks pehle beans aur equipment bechti thi. Howard Schultz Italy ke espresso bars dekh ke drinks laaye; 1987 mein unhone company khareedi.
cards.source: Starbucks company history
cards.followup_sawal: Starbucks India mein kab aur kiske saath aayi?
cards.followup_answer: Oct 2012 mein Mumbai mein, Tata ke saath joint venture (Tata Starbucks) se.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare customers kya leke jaate hain aur kya wahin khaate hain? Data mein dikh sakta hai?

cards.observation: 1985 mein Coca-Cola ne apna 99 saal purana formula badal diya.
cards.question: Customers ke virodh ke baad kya hua?
example_sawal: Formula badalne pe itna gussa kyun?
Kitne din mein palta?
options: 79 din mein purana formula "Coca-Cola Classic" naam se wapas aaya
cards.explanation: 23 April 1985 ko New Coke aaya. Bhaari virodh ke baad 11 July 1985 ko purana formula wapas aaya.
cards.source: The Coca-Cola Company history ("The Real Story of New Coke")
cards.followup_sawal: Launch se pehle taste test mein New Coke kaisa laga tha?
cards.followup_answer: Company ke records ke mutabik blind taste tests mein kai logon ne New Coke ko zyada pasand kiya tha.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare regular customers kis cheez ke badalne pe sabse zyada naraz honge?

cards.observation: 1982 mein Chicago mein kuch logon ki maut Tylenol capsules mein milaye gaye cyanide se hui.
cards.question: Company ne kya kiya?
example_sawal: Itna bada recall kyun?
Packaging kyun badli?
options: Poore US se lagbhag 3.1 crore bottles wapas mangwayi
Sirf Chicago mein daam kam kiya
cards.explanation: Johnson & Johnson ne poore desh se recall kiya aur baad mein seal wali (tamper-resistant) packaging laayi.
cards.source: Johnson & Johnson company history; US FDA records
cards.followup_sawal: Iske baad dawai packaging ke niyam mein kya badla?
cards.followup_answer: 1982 ke aakhir mein US FDA ne over-the-counter dawaiyon ke liye tamper-resistant packaging zaroori ki.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Agar tumhare product pe bharosa toote, customer ko sabse pehle kya dikhna chahiye?

cards.observation: Instagram 2010 mein ek alag app "Burbn" se nikla.
cards.question: Burbn kya tha?
example_sawal: Check-in app photo app kaise bana?
Kitne mein bika?
options: Location check-in app jisme photo bhi daal sakte the
cards.explanation: Kevin Systrom ka Burbn check-in app tha. Founders ke mutabik log sabse zyada photo feature use karte the, to sirf photo pe focus kiya.
cards.source: Kevin Systrom aur Mike Krieger ke interviews; Instagram company history
cards.followup_sawal: Facebook ne Instagram kitne mein khareeda?
cards.followup_answer: 2012 mein lagbhag $1 billion mein.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Customers tumhari kaunsi cheez sabse zyada use karte hain jo tumne "side" mein rakhi thi?

cards.observation: Slack ek online game banane wali company ka andar ka chat tool tha.
cards.question: Game ka kya hua?
example_sawal: Game company chat app kaise bani?
Kisne khareeda?
options: Game "Glitch" band hua, aur team ka chat tool Slack ban gaya
Game abhi bhi chal raha hai
cards.explanation: Tiny Speck ka game Glitch 2012 mein band hua. Team ne apna internal chat tool 2013-14 mein Slack naam se launch kiya.
cards.source: Stewart Butterfield ke statements; Slack company history
cards.followup_sawal: Slack ko 2021 mein kisne khareeda?
cards.followup_answer: Salesforce ne, lagbhag $27.7 billion mein.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhari team roz kaunsa jugaad use karti hai jo shayad khud ek product ho?

cards.observation: IKEA ka furniture dabbe mein, khula hua (flat-pack) aata hai.
cards.question: Ye idea kaise aaya?
example_sawal: Furniture dabbe mein kyun?
Isse kya sasta hua?
options: Ek employee ne table ki taangein kholi taaki car mein fit ho
cards.explanation: 1956 mein IKEA ke Gillis Lundgren ne ek table car mein rakhne ke liye uski taangein khol di. Isse transport aur storage sasta hua.
cards.source: IKEA company history (Lövet table, 1956)
cards.followup_sawal: IKEA ka pehla India store kab aur kahan khula?
cards.followup_answer: Aug 2018 mein Hyderabad mein.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhara kaunsa item packing ki wajah se mehenga ya mushkil padta hai?

cards.observation: Domino's US ka "30 minute mein, warna free" wada 1993 mein band hua.
cards.question: Kyun?
example_sawal: Itna famous wada kyun hataya?
Court ne kya kaha?
options: Delivery accidents pe court cases, aur ek bade jury verdict ke baad
cards.explanation: Tez delivery se jude accidents pe mukadme hue. 1993 mein ek case mein lagbhag $79 million ke jury verdict ke baad Domino's ne US mein guarantee hatayi.
cards.source: New York Times, Dec 1993; Domino's statement
cards.followup_sawal: Domino's India mein kab aaya?
cards.followup_answer: 1996 mein Delhi mein, Jubilant FoodWorks ke saath.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare delivery time ka wada customer pe kya asar daalta hai? Data mein dekh sakte ho?

cards.observation: 1948 mein McDonald brothers ne apna restaurant kuch mahine band kiya aur menu chhota kar diya.
cards.question: Naye menu mein kitne items the?
example_sawal: Menu chhota karne se kya mila?
Kitchen kaise badla?
cards.explanation: Menu 9 items tak kaata, kitchen assembly line jaisa banaya ("Speedee Service System") aur hamburger 15 cents ka kiya.
cards.source: McDonald's Corporation history
cards.followup_sawal: Ray Kroc kaise jude?
cards.followup_answer: 1954 mein milkshake machine bechte hue Kroc ne restaurant dekha; 1961 mein brothers se company khareedi.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare menu ke kaunse items sabse kam bikte hain, aur unhe rakhne ki wajah kya hai?

cards.observation: 2016 mein UK mein Toblerone ke chocolate pahadon (peaks) ke beech ka gap badh gaya.
cards.question: Kyun?
example_sawal: Gap badhane se kya bacha?
Customers ne kya kiya?
options: Weight kam karne ke liye: 400g bar 360g ka hua, daam wahi
cards.explanation: Mondelez ne badhte kharche ka hawala diya. Bar utna hi bada dikhe par chocolate kam ho, isliye gap bada kiya.
cards.source: BBC News, Nov 2016
cards.followup_sawal: Customers ka reaction kya raha?
cards.followup_answer: Bhaari aalochna hui. 2018 mein purana shape wapas aaya, lekin bar ka daam badha diya gaya.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Portion ka chhota badlav tumhare customers notice karte hain kya? Kaise pata karoge?

cards.observation: Coca-Cola ki curvy bottle ka design ek competition se aaya.
cards.question: Design ki shart kya thi?
example_sawal: Bottle ka shape itna zaroori kyun?
Design kisne banaya?
options: Andhere mein chhoo ke ya tooti hui bhi pehchani jaaye
cards.explanation: 1915 mein company ne aisi bottle maangi jo andhere mein chhoo ke bhi pehchani jaaye aur nakli bottles se alag dikhe. Root Glass Company ka design jeeta.
cards.source: The Coca-Cola Company archives (1915 contour bottle)
cards.followup_sawal: Bottle ka shape kis cheez se prerit tha?
cards.followup_answer: Company archives ke mutabik designers ne cocoa pod ki tasveer dekh ke shape banaya.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhara product bina naam ke bhi pehchana ja sakta hai kya?

cards.observation: 1886 mein Coca-Cola pehli baar Atlanta ki ek pharmacy mein bika.
cards.question: Ek glass kitne ka tha?
example_sawal: Pharmacy mein soft drink kyun?
Daam kitne saal same raha?
cards.explanation: John Pemberton ki drink Jacobs' Pharmacy ke soda fountain pe 5 cents glass bikti thi. Pehle saal roz lagbhag 9 glass bikte the.
cards.source: The Coca-Cola Company history
cards.followup_sawal: Coca-Cola ka daam kitne saal 5 cents raha?
cards.followup_answer: Lagbhag 70 saal, 1886 se 1959 tak.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare kis item ka daam sabse lambe samay se nahi badla? Kyun?

cards.observation: Wrigley ki chewing gum shuru mein ek free gift thi.
cards.question: Gum kis cheez ke saath free milti thi?
example_sawal: Free gift khud product kaise bana?
Gum kab bechni shuru ki?
cards.explanation: William Wrigley Jr. pehle saabun, phir baking powder bechte the aur saath mein gum free dete the. Gum zyada pasand aayi to gum hi bechne lage.
cards.source: Wrigley Company history (Mars Wrigley)
cards.followup_sawal: Wrigley ke pehle do gum brands kaunse the?
cards.followup_answer: Juicy Fruit aur Wrigley's Spearmint, 1893 mein.
cards.tumhare_business_sawal: Tumhare "free" ya add-on mein se customers sabse zyada kya maangte hain?
